subtitles.en: Let's turn to Wall Street, though. Firms are poised to take in $90 billion in profits smashing last year's record. Boneses are also expected to reach in all time high.
subtitles.zh: 转向华尔街，机构有望实现900亿美元利润，刷新去年纪录。奖金预计也将创历史新高。

subtitles.en: Joining us now is Herman Chan, senior US bank analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, who's also gearing up for bank earnings next week. Herman, is this just a really strong first half?
subtitles.zh: 彭博情报高级美国银行分析师Herman Chan加入我们，他也在为下周银行财报做准备。Herman，这只是一个非常强劲的上半年吗？

subtitles.en: How much is the second half contributing to what's going to be a banner year for Wall Street?
subtitles.zh: 下半年对华尔街这个辉煌年份的贡献有多大？

subtitles.en: Right. The first step was really spectacular, particularly in equity trading.
subtitles.zh: 对，第一步确实非常惊人，尤其是在权益资产交易方面。

subtitles.en: And also the resurgence of IPO activity within the group. The second half's turning out to be a bit chopier. We've gotten some mixed guidance from the investor
subtitles.zh: 还有IPO活动的复苏。下半年变得有些波动。过去一个月左右，我们从市场参与者会议上得到了一些混合指引。

subtitles.en: conferences over the past month or so where some banks like JP Morgan are expecting continue growth in trading and investment banking, whereas Bank of America seems a bit
subtitles.zh: 像摩根大通这样的银行预计交易和**银行业务持续增长，而美国银行在交易方面似乎有些波动。

subtitles.en: chopier results across the trading front. So mixed results expected for the third quarter, and we'll see what it shapes up for the fourth. Herman, is bringing it back to the local level here.
subtitles.zh: 所以第三季度预计结果混合，我们将看看第四季度如何发展。Herman，回到本地层面。

subtitles.en: This is a big source of revenue for New York, New York City, the state. Generally, these guys are still prudent staying put here, the talent pools here. Are you seeing anything that
subtitles.zh: 这是纽约市和纽约州的重要收入来源。一般来说，这些人仍然谨慎地留在这里，人才池在这里。你看到什么让你认为我们可能更多地进入德克萨斯和佛罗里达这样的地方？

subtitles.en: makes you think that maybe we have more access to this place like Texas and Florida?
subtitles.zh: 你看到什么让你认为我们可能更多地进入德克萨斯和佛罗里达这样的地方？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think you're going to see some more diversification of the footprint for folks in the finance industry. You've seen banks like Morgan Stanley talking about opening up a hub
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为你会看到金融行业人士的足迹更加多样化。你已经看到像摩根士丹利这样的银行谈论开设中心。

subtitles.en: in Dallas, so those things are continued to shape up. I think a lot of it just deals with the tax regime here in New York, whereas a bit more precarious, whereas some tax-friendly or states
subtitles.zh: 在达拉斯，这些情况持续向好。我认为很大程度上与纽约的税收制度有关，而这里更不稳定，相比之下，一些税收友好的州

results.snippet: Title: Hamptons Rentals to Cash In on Record Wall Street Bonuses - Bloomberg # Hamptons Rentals to Cash In on Record Wall Street Bonuses. Record Wall Street bonuses aren’t good news for only those in Manhattan’s finance industry. Some of those funds should also make their way to landlords in the Hamptons, a preferred summer destination for the city’s bankers, said New York State Comptroller Thomas DiNapoli. “The fact that it was a really good year as far as bonuses for folks looking to do rentals on the east end of Long Island, they’re probably feeling very comfortable that they’ll be able to do that,” DiNapoli said at a press conference Thursday. New York’s bankers are set “to benefit from these bonuses and to maintain the lifestyle that they’ve become accustomed to.”.

纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
